hero.heading: Hungarian election campaign simulator
hero.description: Kampánykörút is a free political strategy game in which you run a Hungarian parliamentary election campaign. Campaign district by district, make political decisions, follow the polls, and see whether you manage to win a majority in the National Assembly.

landing.footer: Kampánykörút — a free election simulation that runs in your browser.
